basis: Direct review of critical source and original worker text; no command/tests performed by DeepSeek.

corrected_worker_claims.claim: No exported PPN means reverse pool-address matching has no usable signal
corrected_worker_claims.correction: The registered pool is defined by IOVA VPN/context; IOTLB tags already carry those. A virtual range-derived index needs no PPN. A new functional interface and metadata logic still have to be built; research taps are not free functional interfaces.
axi_pkg::burst_t is2 bits in both provided copies. Each axi_options_t is18 bits, backend_options_t10; total options O=92+AXI ID field width.

corrected_worker_claims.claim: Normal path has no spare selection port
corrected_worker_claims.correction: There is one shared address-query port. A selection query requires actual arbitration and costs; no useful idle slot is established. A reverse metadata index has separate priced logic and may avoid ordinary-port queries, not the cost of selection.

The fill edge writes tags/content but does not itself set PLRU. A successful normal PTW completes through a subsequent ordinary hit; that hit can touch replacement state. Model the complete source permission sequence, not only its fill edge.
